name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Master Next.js 14+ App Router with Server Components, streaming, parallel routes, advanced data fetching. Use when building Next.js applications, implementing SSR/SSG, optimizing React Server Components.

Mode/Where/When:
| Server Components | Server only | Data fetching, heavy computation, secrets |
| Client Components | Browser | Interactivity, hooks, browser APIs |
| Static | Build time | Content that rarely changes |
| Dynamic | Request time | Personalized or real-time data |
| Streaming | Progressive | Large pages, slow data sources |

App structure: layout.tsx, page.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx, route.ts, template.tsx, default.tsx, opengraph-image.tsx
